meta.note: x,z are local offsets from the town centre in index.html world units (x east, z south). rot is a y-axis yaw in radians. 'did' is the client mesh/Setup DataID (GfxObj 0x0100.. or Setup 0x0200..). Buildings/scenery come from the client geometry (no in-game name); named landmarks come from the server weenies (Setup DID where present).
